name: Miller
bio: The surname Miller covers unrelated people in the Cow Boy: Miller of the California cattle firm Miller & Lux, a Cleveland visitor looking for a ranch site in June 1885, and a man named with Moore as facing trial in the Luffsey killing in September 1885. No single bio can be written from these items.
